reviewItem.question: Does "Ignoring ApplicationSet `applyNestedSelectors` field: Setting the `spec.applyNestedSelectors` field in an ApplicationSet resolves counter-intuitive behavior…" mean a change to crd-field:argo-cd|group=argoproj.io|version=v1alpha1|kind=ApplicationSet|path=spec.applyNestedSelectors (behavior-changed)?

change.before: "field value was honored (nested selectors applied only if true)"
change.after: "field is ignored (nested selectors always applied, behavior as if true)"

proposed.statement: The spec.applyNestedSelectors field in ApplicationSet is now ignored in Argo CD 3.0; nested selectors are always applied regardless of the field's value.
